scope: Documentary identity and deterministic mathematical counterexamples only; no estimation, new chains, model selection or production approval.
provenance_acceptance: Exactly seven recovered source-byte identities must match the prior independent audit
Each recovered source must map to the original command, attempt, source path and raw event sequence
Recovered sources are archives, never replacements of canonical or historical files
Old candidates, protocols, logs and raw chains must retain their original bytes or existing explicit frozen mappings
New package inventory must close actual reconstruction inputs, including event records and reconstruction code
Documentary repair cannot promote G3 to PASS or resolve F1/F2

mathematical_cases.F1: N=A=1, m=.999, s=0, tau=nu=.5: exact pW=499.5, parent mass positive
mathematical_cases.F2: N=2, A=1, W=2, m=s=0, tau=nu=.5: impossible electoral event has literal mass 1/32
mathematical_cases.triangle_normalizer: N=2, m=s=0, tau=.5; nu=.2,.5,.8. C=1-tau*(1-tau)*nu^2/2, hence not a data-only constant
mathematical_cases.normalization_order: N=2, tau=nu=.5; equal-weight fixed components (m,s)=(0,0),(.5,0). C0=31/32, C1=55/64. Normalizing the mixture differs from normalizing its components
mathematical_cases.paper_probabilities: pA=(1-tau)*(1-m), pW=tau*nu+(1-tau)*m+tau*(1-nu)*s, pO=tau*(1-nu)*(1-s); formulas read from archived G2 contract, not yet a new review of article provenance
mathematical_cases.independent_binomials: N=1,tau=nu=.5,m=s=0: P(A=W=1)=1/8; conditioning onto triangle is not multinomial
mathematical_cases.multinomial: Compare three-category multinomial to sequential A~Bin(N,pA), W|A~Bin(N-A,pW/(1-pA)), including pA=1 boundary
mathematical_cases.transfer_composition: Marginalize five mutually exclusive categories (unmoved abstention, manufactured, true leader, stolen, unmoved other) for N=1,2,3; compare to three-category multinomial and capacity constraints
mathematical_cases.identification_counterexample: (tau,nu,m,s)=(.7,5/7,0,0) and (.6,.5,.25,1/3) both induce (pA,pW,pO)=(.3,.5,.2), but expected transfers are 0 versus .1N manufactured and .1N stolen
mathematical_cases.grid_scope: Scalar fixed-parameter algebraic fixtures, not draws from qbl latent counts or a substitute fitted model. F1/F2 separately use values in literal count support.

tolerances.probability_support: Strict finite p in [0,1]; no epsilon/clamp to validate invalid probabilities
tolerances.normalization: Require finite positive normalizer before division; normalization is explicitly a different statistical model
tolerances.identification: Exact algebraic equality is the proof; small-N numeric enumeration is only a check

decision_boundary: Prepare evidence and questions, then await user-provided frozen proposal bytes and package identity. Do not issue final pass/changes_requested/inconclusive for an unseen proposal.
